name: vcpkg
description: vcpkg packages: the C and C++ manifests in a folder, the ports each depends on, the version its baseline resolves, what is newer, and search across the vcpkg port list.
detail: Reads vcpkg.json and vcpkg-configuration.json, and the vcpkg registry's published baselines. Adding a port and installing run through the vcpkg on your machine, in a terminal you can see.
